name: Voyager Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as voyagervc.com, the early-stage energy, industrial and climate-tech fund whose homepage announces its $275M Fund II and whose Feb 2024 release describes a $100M Select Fund I (San Francisco and New York offices). Not Voyager Capital (Seattle), not Voyagers Ventures, not Voyager Partners other than this firm's own fund vehicles.

open_items: Only 1 round recorded. Fund II exact close date: Pulse 2.0 is dated Jan 29, 2026 and ESG Today Jan 30; PR Newswire release reported as Jan 28 in search results only. Recorded to the month. Fund I (Voyager Partners Select I, $100M, 2024-02-07) is earlier and not recorded.
Check size not stated on fetched pages. HQ taken from the 2024 release; the homepage shows SF, NY, London and Munich clocks without naming a HQ.
